title: The Data Foundation behind Frontier Transformation
summary: Explore how Everpure supports Microsoft’s Frontier Transformation with unified data, Azure integrations, cyber resilience, and efficient storage for AI workloads.
body_markdown:
### Summary


Everpure provides a unified data foundation for Microsoft’s Frontier Transformation framework, supporting AI workloads with Azure integrations, cloud storage efficiency, and cyber resilience.


[Microsoft Ignite 2026](https://ignite.microsoft.com/en-US/home) brings the Microsoft ecosystem to San Francisco, and the spotlight is on Frontier Transformation. It’s Microsoft’s framework for putting AI into practice across every workflow, decision, and experience, designed for trust at scale. For Everpure, it’s a chance to show what another year of partnership with Microsoft has made possible.


Frontier Transformation raises a practical question about the data underneath. Siloed storage, parallel toolsets, and unpredictable cloud bills slow AI programs before the first agent ships. The budget meant for AI goes to handling complex operations and maintenance instead.


Four outcomes decide whether projects move forward or stall: unified data, control over where workloads run, better cloud economics, and cyber resilience. They support two ideas at the heart of Frontier Transformation, which are reshaping business processes and trust built into the system.


For Everpure, the answer starts with[data primacy](https://blog.everpuredata.com/perspectives/data-processing-to-data-primacy/) : treating data as the primary enterprise asset, with applications following it. Silos shrink when data comes first. The[Enterprise Data Cloud](https://www.everpuredata.com/enterprise-data-cloud.html) puts that into practice. At its core is a[unified data plane](https://blog.everpuredata.com/products/era-of-one-workload/) that spans protocols and workloads, so you manage storage as one system.


[Everpure Cloud](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/cloud.html) brings that unified data plane to Azure. It extends enterprise storage across on premises and public cloud, so workloads can run where they need to. Consistent data services and enterprise-grade protection support cyber resilience. Built-in data reduction improves efficiency and lowers cloud storage costs.


## What’s new for Everpure since the last Ignite


- **Everpure Cloud Azure Native for Azure Virtual Machines:** This fully managed block storage service is built into Azure. Manage it through the Azure portal, ARM, Bicep, and Terraform.[Read more](https://blog.everpuredata.com/products/everpure-cloud-azure-native-expands/) .
- **Everpure Cloud VM Extension:** It automates iSCSI, multipathing, and volume mounts on Linux and Windows guests. It works with Everpure Cloud Azure Native and Everpure Cloud Dedicated.[Learn more](https://blog.everpuredata.com/news-events/announcing-general-availability-of-everpure-cloud-vm-extension/) .
- **Everpure Cloud with Microsoft Azure Red Hat OpenShift:** Virtual machines and containers run on one platform. It targets up to 40% lower cloud storage costs.[See how](https://blog.everpuredata.com/products/everpure-cloud-and-azure-red-hat-open-shift/) .
- **Everpure FlashArray™ with Azure Local:** Now generally available, customers can leverage Everpure™[FlashArray](https://www.purestorage.com/products/unified-block-file-storage.html) as external, high-performance storage connected via either Fibre Channel or iSCSI.[Find out more](https://blog.everpuredata.com/solutions/pure-storage-microsoft-partner-azure-local-support-flasharray-as-external-storage/) .
